ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 (ScarCruft) HWP/CHM lure → PowerShell → RokRAT staging via legitimate cloud C2
ucs.description: Hunts APT37's signature South-Korea-focused infection chain: a weaponized HWP (Hancom) or CHM document delivered via spearphishing spawns scripting hosts (powershell/wscript/mshta) which then beacon to cloud-hosted C2 (pCloud, Yandex, Dropbox, Box, Mediafire) — the legitimate-service-as-C2 pattern is core to RokRAT/BLUELIGHT/Dolphin tradecraft.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.process_name) as process_name values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_process from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("hwp.exe","hwp32.exe","hwp80.exe","hncbgmh.exe","hwp.exe","hshell.exe","hsrt.exe","hwpviewer.exe","hcc.exe","hh.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","outlook.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| join type=inner dest [
    | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count from datamodel=Web where Web.dest_category="cloud_storage" OR Web.url IN ("*pcloud.com*","*api.pcloud.com*","*yandex*","*dropboxapi*","*mediafire*","*box.com/api*","*content.dropboxapi.com*") by Web.src Web.dest Web.url
    | rename Web.src as dest Web.url as c2_url
    | fields dest c2_url
  ]
| where _time > relative_time(now(), "-24h")
ucs.kql:
// APT37 / ScarCruft — HWP/CHM/Office lure spawning script host followed by cloud-service C2 within 5 minutes
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMin = 5;
let KoreanOfficeParents = dynamic(["hwp.exe","hwp32.exe","hwp80.exe","hncbgmh.exe","hshell.exe","hsrt.exe","hwpviewer.exe","hcc.exe","hh.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let ScriptChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe"]);
let CloudC2Hosts = dynamic(["api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","api.mediafire.com","www.mediafire.com","upload.box.com","api.box.com"]);
let ScriptHosts = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (KoreanOfficeParents)
    | where FileName in~ (ScriptChildren)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ScriptTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPid = ProcessId,
              ChildSHA256 = SHA256;
let CloudBeacon = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (ScriptChildren)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (CloudC2Hosts)
          or RemoteUrl matches regex @"(?i)\.(pcloud|yandex|dropboxapi|mediafire|box)\.com"
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, BeaconProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              BeaconPid = InitiatingProcessId, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
ScriptHosts
| join kind=inner CloudBeacon on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (ScriptTime .. ScriptTime + WindowMin * 1m)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, ScriptTime)
| project ScriptTime, NetTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage, ChildImage, ChildCmd, BeaconProc, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, ChildSHA256
| order by ScriptTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT37 / ScarCruft — Sentinel port via SecurityEvent 4688 (host) + CommonSecurityLog (proxy/firewall)
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMin = 5;
let KoreanOfficeParents = dynamic(["hwp.exe","hwp32.exe","hwp80.exe","hncbgmh.exe","hshell.exe","hsrt.exe","hwpviewer.exe","hcc.exe","hh.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let ScriptChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe"]);
let CloudC2 = dynamic(["pcloud.com","yandex.net","dropboxapi.com","mediafire.com","box.com","webdav.yandex.com"]);
let ScriptHosts = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ParentBase = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | extend ChildBase  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ParentBase in (KoreanOfficeParents)
    | where ChildBase in (ScriptChildren)
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ScriptTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              ParentBase, ChildBase, CommandLine, NewProcessId;
let CloudBeacon = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DeviceVendor in~ ("Palo Alto Networks","Zscaler","Fortinet","Cisco","Check Point","Microsoft")
    | where DestinationHostName has_any (CloudC2) or RequestURL has_any (CloudC2)
    | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, Computer = DeviceName,
              DstHost = coalesce(DestinationHostName, RequestURL),
              DstIP = DestinationIP, SrcUser = SourceUserName;
ScriptHosts
| join kind=inner CloudBeacon on Computer
| where NetTime between (ScriptTime .. ScriptTime + WindowMin * 1m)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, ScriptTime)
| project ScriptTime, NetTime, DelaySec, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          ParentBase, ChildBase, CommandLine, DstHost, DstIP
| order by ScriptTime desc

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(hwp(32|80)?|hncbgmh|hshell|hsrt|hwpviewer|hcc|hh|winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|cmd)\.exe$/i

| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(pcloud|yandex|dropboxapi|mediafire|box)\.(com|net)/i | rename(field=ContextImageFileName, as=BeaconImage) | rename(field=DomainName, as=C2Domain)}, field=aid, include=[C2Domain, BeaconImage])

ucs.rationale: APT37/ScarCruft is uniquely identified by (a) targeting Hancom Office (HWP) — the Korean-market document format almost no other tracked APT weaponizes — and (b) the BLUELIGHT/RokRAT/Dolphin family's hallmark of using legitimate cloud-storage APIs (pCloud, Yandex Disk, Dropbox, Mediafire, Box) for C2 instead of attacker-controlled infrastructure. ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 ROKRAT/CHINOTTO persistence via HKCU Run key written by scripting host (Group123 tradecraft)
ucs.description: Hunts APT37's CHINOTTO/RokRAT autostart trick: a script interpreter (powershell/wscript/cscript/mshta) writes an HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run value pointing to rundll32, regsvr32, mshta, or an LNK/JS/VBS payload in %APPDATA%/%TEMP% — the user-hive Run-key persistence written by a script child is the documented Group123/ScarCruft post-exploitation step (T1547.001).
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Registry.registry_value_data) as registry_value_data values(Registry.process_name) as process_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path IN ("*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*","*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\*") AND Registry.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe") by Registry.dest Registry.user Registry.registry_path Registry.registry_value_name Registry.registry_value_data Registry.process_name Registry.process 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` 
| where match(registry_value_data, "(?i)(\\\\AppData\\\\|\\\\Temp\\\\|\\\\Public\\\\|\\\\ProgramData\\\\)") OR match(registry_value_data, "(?i)(rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|wscript|cscript|powershell)\\.exe") OR match(registry_value_data, "(?i)\\.(lnk|js|vbs|hta|bat|ps1|dll)\"?$")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// APT37 / Group123 / CHINOTTO — script host writing HKCU Run-key persistence to a user-writable path
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has_any (
    @"\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",
    @"\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce",
    @"\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Shell Folders",
    @"\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows\Load")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)(\\AppData\\|\\Temp\\|\\Public\\|\\ProgramData\\|%APPDATA%|%TEMP%|%PUBLIC%)"
      or RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)\b(rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|wscript|cscript|powershell|pwsh)\.exe\b"
      or RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)\.(lnk|js|jse|vbs|vbe|hta|bat|ps1|dll)\b"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessParentFileName, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName,
          RegistryValueData
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT37 / Group123 / CHINOTTO — Sentinel port via Sysmon EID 13 (RegistryValueSet)
Event
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 13
| extend EventDataXml = parse_xml(EventData)
| extend ed = EventDataXml.DataItem.EventData.Data
| mv-apply d = ed on (extend k = tostring(d["@Name"]), v = tostring(d["#text"]))
| summarize Props = make_bag(pack(k, v)) by TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID
| extend TargetObject = tostring(Props["TargetObject"]),
         Details      = tostring(Props["Details"]),
         Image        = tostring(Props["Image"]),
         User         = tostring(Props["User"])
| extend ImageBase = tolower(tostring(split(Image, "\\")[-1]))
| where TargetObject matches regex @"(?i)\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\(CurrentVersion\\Run(Once)?|NT\\CurrentVersion\\Windows\\Load)"
| where ImageBase in ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe")
| where User !endswith "$"
| where Details matches regex @"(?i)(\\AppData\\|\\Temp\\|\\Public\\|\\ProgramData\\|%APPDATA%|%TEMP%|%PUBLIC%)"
      or Details matches regex @"(?i)\b(rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|wscript|cscript|powershell|pwsh)\.exe\b"
      or Details matches regex @"(?i)\.(lnk|js|jse|vbs|vbe|hta|bat|ps1|dll)\b"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, User, Image, TargetObject, Details
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: APT37 ScarCruft - Script Host Writing HKCU Run Key Persistence
id: 7b2c9f3e-8d4a-4c5f-9a1b-3e2d1f7c8a01
status: experimental
description: Detects APT37 (ScarCruft / Group123) CHINOTTO and RokRAT persistence — a script interpreter writes an HKCU Run/RunOnce value pointing at a user-writable path or LOLBin
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
  - https://securelist.com/scarcruft-surveillance-tools/105482/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1547.001
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: registry_set
detection:
  selection_key:
    TargetObject|contains:
      - '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\'
      - '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce\'
      - '\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows\Load'
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  selection_payload:
    Details|contains:
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - 'rundll32.exe'
      - 'regsvr32.exe'
      - 'mshta.exe'
      - 'wscript.exe'
      - 'cscript.exe'
      - '.lnk'
      - '.js'
      - '.vbs'
      - '.hta'
      - '.ps1'
      - '.dll'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_key and selection_proc and selection_payload and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate installers that script user-hive Run entries (rare on enterprise endpoints)
level: high
